sloka: मम मातुर्महद्दुःखमतुलम् शुभलक्षम्ण ।अभिप्रायम् अविज्ञाय सत्यस्य च शमस्य च ॥२-२१-३९॥
transliteration: mama māturmahadduḥkhamatulam śubhalakṣamṇa ।abhiprāyam avijñāya satyasya ca śamasya ca ॥2-21-39॥

translations.english: O Lakshamana of auspicious qualities, since my mother is not aware of the significance of truth and selfrestraint, she is overcome with grief, great and incomparable.
